SYMPTOM: On fresh simulator, globe button cycles through built-in keyboards only, WhisnapKeyboard process never launches, no crash logs.
CAUSE: iOS requirement — the containing app must be opened at least once before its keyboard extension enters the input mode rotation. Without this, iOS discovers the extension (PlugInKit shows it registered) but never activates it.
FIX: Added helpers/launch-app.yaml that must be run before keyboard tests on fresh simulators. run-all.sh updated to always launch app before keyboard tests.
PREVENT: Always include app launch step in fresh-install test sequences. This is a permanent iOS platform requirement, not a bug to fix.
